name: uv_close

ownership.argument: Call on owning loop. Handle and callback must remain alive through the eventual close callback. Feature manager allocates its async as112 bytes at 0xC865744.

provenance.source: Feature manager close 0xC86576C checks uv_is_closing 0xC2DB98C and calls 0xC2DB874(async, 0xC86539D); close reads flags at handle+0x5C, sets closing bit and callback at +12, dispatches by handle type.

notes: Call on owning loop. Handle and callback must remain alive through the eventual close callback. Feature manager allocates its async as112 bytes at 0xC865744.
